arguments.value: Fred Wallace Slaughter is a United States District Judge for the Central District of California, appointed by President Joe Biden and confirmed in 2022. Born in Santa Monica, California, in 1973, he earned his B.A. from the University of California, Los Angeles, in 1996 and his J.D. from UCLA School of Law in 1999. He began his legal career as a deputy city attorney in Los Angeles, then served as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of Arizona, the Central District of California, and the District of Oregon. From 2014 to 2022, he served as a judge of the Superior Court of California, County of Orange, before joining the federal bench.
